sql:
SELECT p.PromotionCategory AS PromotionCategory,
       sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscount,
       sum(f.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullif((SELECT sum(DiscountAmount) FROM retail.FactOnlineSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND PromotionKey <> 1), 0) AS SharePct,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(f.DiscountAmount) DESC) AS Rank
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  AND f.PromotionKey <> 1
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY TotalDiscount DESC
